verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs describe a full workflow—tracing code, planning, reproducing issues, running background agents to build/test/demo, and integrating with GitHub/Linear for issue tracking and PR review—suggesting an end-to-end issue-to-PR path. However, there is no concrete evidence of this specific workflow succeeding in practice, and community feedback repeatedly describes the product as buggy and inconsistent, casting doubt on reliability for complex end-to-end tasks.
